_comment: Canonical batch request for the 4 Pacquiao vs Broner boxing clips. All durations are <60s and pass the canonical ProcessYouTubeSegmentUseCase::SegmentPolicy gate ([Min=4s, Max=60s]). Wire shape mirrors /api/clips/process ExtractRequest (internal/capabilities/youtube/dto/types.go). drift source of truth: dto/types.go::ExtractRequest.

segments.name: Round 7 — Pacquiao hurts Broner
segments.summary: Pacquiao hurts Broner badly near the ropes. Crowd reacts. Test target: clip cut accuracy + original commentary + crowd/punch audio fidelity.
segments.hook: Broner is almost stopped while the arena reacts.

segments.name: Round 9 — Pressione all'angolo
segments.summary: Pressione all'angolo, cambio scena, camera movement. Audio: colpi + reazione del pubblico.
segments.hook: Pacquiao works the body while Broner covers up.

segments.name: Round 12 — Controllo finale
segments.summary: Controllo finale del match, audio campana/finale, continuità di scena.

segments.name: Verdetto — Finale match
segments.summary: Annuncio finale, parlato, audio pulito, decisione dei giudici.
segments.hook: The judges announce the verdict in favor of Pacquiao.
